colorExtractor.title: Image Color Extractor
colorExtractor.description: Extract colors from images. Supports click-to-pick, auto palette extraction, and HEX/RGB/HSL conversion.
colorExtractor.dragDrop: Drag & drop or click to upload an image
colorExtractor.clickToExtract: Click on the image to extract colors

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: Drag an image or use the upload button to load an image
Click anywhere on the image to extract the color at that position
Use the magnifier to pinpoint the exact location
Auto palette extracts 10 dominant colors from the image
Export extracted colors as CSS variables, Tailwind, or JSON format

tips.title: Tips
items: Click a color card to copy the HEX value to clipboard
Use palette export to apply directly to your design system
Check extraction history for previously picked colors
Great for web design, branding, and UI color reference

whatIs.title: What is the Image Color Extractor?
whatIs.description: The Image Color Extractor analyzes photos and image files to identify and extract dominant colors as a visual palette. You can click directly on any pixel to pick its exact color, or automatically extract the most prominent colors from the entire image. Extracted values are instantly available in HEX, RGB, and HSL formats. Ideal for designers, developers, and marketers.

items.q: How many colors are extracted automatically?
items.a: By default, the top 5–10 most dominant colors are extracted. You can adjust the number of colors in settings.
All browser-supported formats including JPG, PNG, GIF, and WebP. Upload via file picker or drag and drop.

items.q: Can I save the extracted color palette?
items.a: Yes. Copy individual color codes to clipboard or export the entire palette as CSS custom properties.
